description: Distributed saga transaction coordinator executes compensation rollback steps in forward FIFO order instead of reverse LIFO order, breaking transaction consistency.
spec_notes: Invariant: On step failure, only successfully completed prior steps must be compensated, and they must execute in strict reverse (LIFO) order.

repo_files.step.py:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable, Any

@dataclass
class SagaStep:
    name: str
    action: Callable[[dict], None]
    compensate: Callable[[dict], None]

tests.test_saga.py:
from step import SagaStep
from context import SagaContext
from saga import SagaCoordinator

def test_successful_saga():
    ctx = SagaContext()
    coordinator = SagaCoordinator(ctx)
    
    coordinator.add_step(SagaStep("step1", lambda d: d.update({"s1": 1}), lambda d: d.pop("s1", None)))
    coordinator.add_step(SagaStep("step2", lambda d: d.update({"s2": 2}), lambda d: d.pop("s2", None)))
    
    assert coordinator.execute() is True
    assert ctx.execution_log == ["step1:action", "step2:action"]
    assert ctx.data == {"s1": 1, "s2": 2}

def test_rollback_reverse_lifo_order():
    ctx = SagaContext()
    coordinator = SagaCoordinator(ctx)
    
    coordinator.add_step(SagaStep("payment", lambda d: d.update({"paid": True}), lambda d: d.update({"refund": True})))
    coordinator.add_step(SagaStep("inventory", lambda d: d.update({"reserved": True}), lambda d: d.update({"unreserved": True})))
    
    def fail_shipping(d):
        raise RuntimeError("Shipping service down")
        
    coordinator.add_step(SagaStep("shipping", fail_shipping, lambda d: None))
    
    success = coordinator.execute()
    assert success is False
    # Invariant: inventory was completed second, so it must be compensated FIRST, then payment
    expected = [
        "payment:action",
        "inventory:action",
        "shipping:failed",
        "inventory:compensate",
        "payment:compensate",
    ]
    assert ctx.execution_log == expected
